privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We respect your privacy and protect your data. This policy explains what we collect, why, for how long, and how you control it.
privacy.h1: What we collect when you order
privacy.li1: Contact details such as your name, phone and address, to fulfil orders, repairs and replacements.
privacy.li2: Order details and your purchase and repair history.
privacy.li3: Processing your orders and keeping you updated on them.
privacy.li4: Improving our service and the shopping experience.
privacy.li5: Always, with no identifier: the pages you visit, the site that referred you, your device type, browser and system family, language, and the country, province and city as our network estimates them. This count ends when you close the tab.
privacy.li6: Only with your consent: a random id kept in your browser so we can recognise return visits, and a link between the visit and your account if you are signed in.
privacy.li7: Only with your consent to ad measurement: the click code an ad platform (Google, Meta, TikTok or Snapchat) adds to the link, so we know which ad brought you. We never share your name or number with those platforms.
privacy.li8: We never collect your IP address, your precise location, a fingerprint of your device, or anything you type into forms.
privacy.li9: Visit records are deleted automatically after about 13 months, and ad click codes after 90 days.
privacy.li10: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time from “Privacy settings” at the foot of the site, and erase your visit history with one press, right here.
privacy.p2: We never sell your data or share it with third parties for their marketing. To see, correct or delete your data, contact us.

Admin.challengesHint: What a customer has to do to earn points. The shelf above is what the points buy.
Admin.challengesUnavailable: Challenges need a database update that has not been applied on this deployment yet.
Admin.chooseAccountHint: Somebody joins the team by having their account chosen, not by having a new one created for them here.
Admin.chooseAccountNote: Anyone without an account signs up on the site first, then appears here. People already on the team are not listed.
Admin.claimedTimes: {count, plural, =0 {never claimed} one {claimed once} other {claimed # times}}
Admin.codesExpiryHint: Optional, and applied to this whole batch. An expired code is never issued.
Admin.codesLoaded: {added} added, {skipped} already in stock and skipped.
Admin.codesToLoadHint: One per line. Add a PIN after a comma, a tab or two spaces if the publisher issues one. Codes already loaded are skipped rather than rejected.
Admin.collectionHint: Give this shelf a URL slug to turn it into a collection with its own page — a Ramadan shelf, say — with a picture and a window it takes itself down at the end of.
Admin.collectionSlugHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens. It appears in the address: /collection/ramadan
Admin.consentHint: What visitors chose in this period.
Admin.contentAboutHint: The sections of /about, in order. Switch one off to take it off the page without losing it.
Admin.contentHint: The shop's own pages: the news and the about page. Both are public the moment they are saved.
Admin.contentNewsHint: Posts on /news. A pinned post stays at the top; a draft is visible to nobody until it is published. Customers can react and comment once signed in.
Admin.contentUnavailable: The news and about pages need 20260919_site_content.sql. Apply it in the SQL editor, then reload.
Admin.counterCouponHint: Applied by the till like any other code.
Admin.counterCustomerHint: Name and number as the customer gives them. Linking an account files the sale under it and earns them their points.
Admin.counterFailed: That did not go through. Try again.
Admin.counterIntentHint: What the customer came in for. A swap records which of ours they want, so whoever settles it is not working it out from a note.
Admin.counterItemsHint: Search the catalogue and add each item. Prices are the catalogue's; the till re-derives every one.
Admin.counterLinkAccountHint: Optional. Search by name or number.
Admin.counterNoLines: Nothing added yet — search for a product above.
Admin.counterNotReassigned: Filed, but it is still under your account — open the row and set the customer.
Admin.originCounterHint: Entered by staff from the dashboard or the repair app.
Admin.originWebHint: Sent in by the customer from the site.
Admin.counterSaleDoneOpen: Filed in review. Move it along from the orders board when the goods go out.
Admin.counterSaleDoneSettled: Filed as delivered. It is on the orders board and in the day's takings.
Admin.counterSaleHint: A sale made across the counter, priced exactly as the website would price it.
Admin.counterSaleUnavailable: Counter sales need a database update that has not been applied yet (20260920_counter_orders.sql).
Admin.counterSettle: The customer took the goods — file as delivered
Admin.counterSettleOff: The order waits in review — for goods being reserved rather than handed over.
Admin.counterSettleOn: The order is filed as delivered: stock leaves the shelf, points are paid, and a linked customer is told.
Admin.counterUnavailable: This is not switched on for this deployment.
Admin.counter_cart_too_large: Too many lines for one sale.
Admin.counter_invalid_customer: That account is not a customer account.
Admin.counter_invalid_name: The customer's name is too short.
Admin.counter_invalid_phone: Enter a valid Iraqi mobile number.
Admin.counter_invalid_phone2: The backup number is not valid.
Admin.countriesHint: As our network estimates it — no IP address is stored.
Admin.couponCodeHint: What the customer types. Letters, numbers, dash and underscore; 3–24 characters. It cannot be changed once orders have used it.
Admin.couponLimits: How often it can be used
Admin.couponLimitsHint: Leave either blank for no limit.
Admin.couponTargetHint: Leave it empty and anybody can type the code. Add one or more accounts and it becomes theirs alone.
Admin.couponTargetWarn: A code aimed at named accounts only works for somebody signed in as one of them, and most of this shop's customers check out as guests. Send it over WhatsApp and remind them to sign in.
Admin.couponThresholdHint: The smallest basket this code works on. Leave at zero to let it apply to any order.
Admin.couponThresholdShown: A shopper under {amount} is shown how much more to add to unlock it, so the code motivates a larger basket instead of waiting to be typed.
Admin.couponTitleHint: For this page only. Never shown to the customer.
Admin.couponTypeFixedHint: The same number of dinars whatever the basket.
Admin.couponTypePercentHint: A share of the basket. Scales with what they spend.
Admin.couponWindowHint: Both are optional. No start means it works immediately; no end means it runs until switched off.
Admin.coupon_code_invalid: A code is 3–24 characters: letters, numbers, dash or underscore, no spaces.
Admin.coupon_value_invalid: Enter a discount greater than zero.
Admin.coupon_window_invalid: The end date is before the start date.
Admin.couponsHint: Codes a customer types into the cart. Use a minimum basket to build a spend threshold — “spend 15,000 and save 10%” — which the cart then advertises on its own.
Admin.create_failed: The account could not be created.
Admin.crewAboutHint: A sentence or two. Leave it empty if there is nothing to say.
Admin.crewAddTitle: Add somebody to the team page
Admin.crewCreateHint: The name comes from their account — edit it to however customers should see it.
Admin.crewEmpty: Nobody is on the team page yet. Add someone from the list below so customers can see and rate them.
Admin.crewErr_forbidden: You do not have permission to edit employee cards.
Admin.crewErr_name_required: The name is required in both Arabic and English.
Admin.crewErr_upload_failed: Could not upload that image. Try another one.
Admin.crewIdentityHint: What a customer reads on the card, which is not always the full name on the account.
Admin.crewMissingBody: Somebody without a card is invisible to customers and cannot be rated. Press a name to create theirs.
Admin.crewMissingTitle: {count} on the roster are not on the team page
Admin.crewNoFeedback: Nobody has written anything about this person yet.
Admin.crewPhotoHint: PNG or JPG. Converted to WebP and capped at 512px in the browser before upload, with the camera data stripped. Without one the initial is drawn instead.
Admin.crewPublicHint: Hiding removes the card from the storefront and leaves every rating intact.
Admin.crewRemoveBody: The card disappears from the team page. Ratings and feedback are kept.
Admin.crewThanksMessage: Hello {name}, thank you for rating our team at Al-Esnad Company.
Admin.customerBlockedExplain: This number cannot place an order, book a repair or submit a buy-back.
Admin.customerNotesHint: What colleagues have written. A warning is counted on the row; only an owner can remove one.
Admin.customerReliabilityHint: How this person treats an order once it is placed.
Admin.customerRevenueExplain: Delivered spend across every customer — money actually taken, not money ordered.
Admin.customer_is_staff: This account belongs to a member of staff. Take them off the staff first, on the staff page.
Admin.customer_on_bench: This person is on the bench and takes tickets. Take them off the bench first, on the staff page.
Admin.deleteRecordBody_order: The order is cancelled first, so its stock, coupon and any linked replacement go back, and then it leaves every board and every total. The record stays in the database.
Admin.deleteRecordBody_repair: The ticket leaves the repair and programming boards and every total. The record stays in the database.
Admin.deleteRecordBody_trade_in: The request leaves the replacement board and every total. The record stays in the database.
Admin.deliveryCollectedExplain: Delivery fees collected across delivered orders. Money that passes through, not margin.
Admin.deliveryFeeHint: The delivery fee this offer charges instead. Set it to zero for free delivery.
Admin.deliveryScopeHint: The basket has to contain at least one of the items above for this delivery price to apply. Leave the scope on "Everything" to give it on every order.
Admin.deliveryScopeTitle: This one is applied at the till
Admin.deputiesHint: People who stand in for {name} over this team — to watch how it is doing, or to change what it may do.
Admin.deputiesUnavailable: Deputies need a database update that has not been applied yet (20260920_team_deputies.sql).
Admin.deputyAccessNote: A deputy still needs the Team section (and, to manage, the team.manage capability) from the staff page to open this page.
Admin.deskAssignChangeHint: You can move it from anyone to anyone at any time. Technicians see it under My tickets.
Admin.deskAssignHint: Give it to a technician now, or keep it with a manager or assistant until one is chosen.
Admin.deskDeferred: {count, plural, =0 {No deferred tickets} one {# deferred ticket} other {# deferred tickets}}
Admin.deskFaultHint: Everything wrong with it, not just the main one. Not on the list? Type it and press Enter — it joins the list and is suggested on the next tickets.
Admin.deskFaultSearch: Search, or type a new fault
Admin.deskFaultManageHint: Rename a fault or take it off the list. Tickets that carry it are not affected.
Admin.deskFaultRenameBody: «{from}» will read «{to}» on the list and on every ticket that carries it.
Admin.deskFaultRetireTitle: Take this fault off the list?
Admin.deskFaultRetireBody: «{name}» will not be offered on new tickets. Tickets that carry it stay as they are.
Admin.fault_name_short: Write a name of at least two letters.
Admin.fault_name_taken: The list already has a fault by that name.
Admin.needs_connection: This needs a connection. Try again once the line is back.
Admin.deskFaultMax: Eight faults at most on one ticket
Admin.deskFaultKeepOne: Keep at least one fault — the ticket is about something.
Admin.deskFaultsEditHint: Add or remove a fault right here, without opening a new ticket. Each change is saved at once.
Admin.deskNewFaultsAsText: The ticket is open, but the new faults could not be added to the list, so they were kept on this ticket as text. Run 20261116_repair_faults_editable.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.fault_not_filed: The new fault could not be added to the list. Pick one from it, or run 20261116_repair_faults_editable.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.too_many_issues: Eight faults at most on one ticket.
Admin.unknown_issue: One of the faults is no longer on the list. Refresh the page and pick again.
Admin.invalid_fault: Write the fault with two letters at least.
Admin.ticket_not_found: This ticket was not found — it may have been deleted.
Admin.faultsUnavailable: Changing a ticket's faults needs a database update: run 20261116_repair_faults_editable.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.deskFaultsNotSaved: The ticket is open, but the new faults you typed could not be saved. Add them from the ticket's window.
Admin.deskFinanceNotSaved: The ticket is open, but its money could not be saved. Enter it from the ticket.
Admin.deskOlderOpen: {count, plural, one {# open ticket from an earlier day} other {# open tickets from earlier days}}
Admin.deskReadOnlyManager: You can read this ticket and not change it: it is with your manager, or with somebody outside your team.
Admin.deskReadOnlyTech: This one is here to read. You work on the tickets assigned to you, under My tickets.
Admin.deskScopeAll: Figures for everyone on the desk
Admin.deskSearchPlaceholder: Ticket code, customer name, number, device, notes…
Admin.deskScopeEdited: Tickets changed after they were opened
Admin.deskEditedHint: Changed after it was opened, last on {when}
Admin.deskTechSub: The tickets assigned to you, and everything on the bench to read.
Admin.deskTruncated: The chosen period holds more than can be shown. Narrow the period or the search.
Admin.deskUnavailable: The programming bench is not switched on in the database yet. Run 20261030_repair_desk.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.deviceRuleOff: Until 20261031_device_discount_rule.sql is run, codes and whole-basket offers still come off phones, tablets and used devices.
Admin.deviceRuleOffTitle: The rule for devices is not switched on yet
Admin.devicesHint: Left off, this code comes off everything else in the basket and leaves those aisles at full price. Customers' reward vouchers can never reach them.
Admin.devicesOfferHint: Left off, this offer comes off everything else in the basket and leaves those aisles at full price. An offer that names an aisle, type or product applies to it without this.
Admin.devicesToggle: Also applies to phones, tablets and used devices
Admin.digitalStockHint: A top-up card's stock is a list of codes, not a number — each one sells exactly once. Running out is not quiet: the till refuses the whole order, so a customer hears about it mid-payment.
Admin.digital_unavailable: Instant delivery is not deployed yet. Apply 20260831_digital_delivery.sql.
Admin.discountCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing discounted} one {# product} other {# products}}
Admin.discountManualNote: Editing a price here changes the product itself, exactly as the catalogue editor does.
Admin.discountOwnedHint: This price belongs to an offer. Change it where the offer is edited, or it will be restored the next time that offer is saved.
Admin.discountRateHint: Discounts as a share of goods before discount.
Admin.discountRegisterHint: Every product currently marked down, wherever the price came from — typed into a product, set by a flash offer, or applied by the home page's offers band. All three write the same two columns, which is what the till reads.
Admin.discount_failed: Saved, but the discount could not be applied.
Admin.discount_unavailable: Saved, but the discount could not be applied: the database migration has not been run yet.
Admin.discountsExplain: Coupons, offers and product markdowns given away.
Admin.discountsUnattributed: Migration 20260826_offers_at_the_till.sql has not been run, so this page cannot tell which discounts belong to an offer. Every row is shown as typed by hand.
Admin.email_taken: An account already uses that email. Promote the existing account instead.
Admin.feedbackEmpty: Nobody has rated the site yet. The question is asked when a visitor is about to leave.
Admin.filterCodeLocked: Fixed once created — it appears in every shared link.
Admin.filterKindCategoryHint: What sort of thing it is: Phones, Tablets.
Admin.filterKindHint: Set on creation only — the code is a key in one of three tables and cannot be moved afterwards.
Admin.filterKindSubcategoryHint: A branch inside a category: Accessories → Cases.
Admin.filterProductsHint: Optional — stops the filter being born empty for a customer to find before we do.
Admin.filterProductsMoveWarning: {count} product(s) will move here and leave whatever they are in now — a product has one category and one brand.
Admin.filtersHint_brand: Cuts across every category. Shown in the store sidebar.
Admin.filtersHint_category: The top-level choice — the home grid and the store tabs.
Admin.filtersHint_subcategory: Narrows one category. Shown in the store sidebar.
Admin.finalOfferHint: The amount agreed with the customer after inspecting the device.
Admin.financeHint: The customer sees none of this — only the repair amount.
Admin.financeProfitHint: The repair's own margin: the repair price less the purchase price. The warranty is a separate account and is not in it.
Admin.financeUnavailable: Saving the purchase price and payments is not switched on yet. Run 20261030_repair_desk.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.financeUnavailableError: Saving the money is not switched on yet.
Admin.flaggedExplain: Customers with a refused parcel, a warning on file, or a block. The people to read before agreeing the next delivery.
Admin.followsRole: This account gets exactly what its role grants. Untick anything below to narrow it.
Admin.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
Admin.forbidden_role_change: The database refused the role change: this one needs an owner.
Admin.geoAreasPrompt: Hover a governorate — or tap one — to see its districts.
Admin.geoBusiestHint: Where the shop is already selling.
Admin.geoIntro: Derived from the place each request came from, never from an address we store. It is a guess — Iraqi carriers route whole regions through Baghdad — so read it as where demand is, not as where one customer lives.
Admin.geoNoneYet: No district has recorded anything yet.
Admin.geoOpportunityHint: Visits with no order behind them. These already know the shop — the gap is a reason to buy, not awareness.
Admin.geoPending: Switched on, but nothing has been recorded yet. Figures appear as orders and visits come in.
Admin.geoUnavailable: District figures are not switched on for this deployment. Apply 20261021_geo_activity.sql to start recording where orders and visits come from.
Admin.geoUnplaced: {orders} orders and {visits} visits could not be placed and are left out of every figure here.
Admin.geoUntouchedHint: Districts with neither a visit nor an order. Reaching them is an advertising question, not a shop one.
Admin.geoByProvinceHint: The lists above mix districts from every governorate and show only the top few. This is all of them, busiest first.
Admin.giftsWaiting: {count, plural, one {# gift to hand over} other {# gifts to hand over}}
Admin.goalEditorHint: Everybody who reports to you sees it as a progress bar on their page. It counts from the start of each month.
Admin.goalNone: Your manager has not set a goal for this month yet.
Admin.goalUnavailable: Team goals are not switched on yet.
Admin.goalUnavailableNote: Team goals are not switched on yet. Run 20261030_repair_desk.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Admin.goal_target_invalid: The target is a number from 1 to 100,000.
Admin.grantExceedsRoleHint: Capabilities ticked that this base role does not carry — the control is offered and the database refuses the save.
Admin.grantExceedsRoleTitle: The database will refuse some of these
Admin.grant_unavailable: The role was saved. The per-person permissions were not — that table is not there yet.
Admin.grantsUnavailable: Roles can be changed here now, but narrowing an individual needs supabase/migrations/20260819_staff_access.sql. Until it is applied everyone keeps exactly what their role grants.
Admin.grossRevenueExplain: Everything customers paid in the period, cancelled orders excluded: goods after discounts, plus delivery collected, minus what was settled against a replacement.
Admin.iconHint: A lucide icon name, e.g. smartphone, watch, headphones.
Admin.iconPickHint: The glyph drawn on the home-page tile and on the row above.
Admin.in_use: Products are still filed under it — move them first.
Admin.inheritHint: Leave the glyph and colour unset and this type is drawn in its category's own look.
Admin.invalid_customer: That customer could not be identified.
Admin.invalid_email: That email address does not look right.
Admin.invalid_points: The points must be at least 1.
Admin.invalid_role: That is not a role this page can assign.
Admin.invalid_target: The target must be at least 1.
Admin.jobsBoardUnavailable: The openings table is not in this database yet — apply 20260922_jobs.sql.
Admin.jobsApplicationUrlHint: Enter the full HTTPS address of the application page.
Admin.jobsDeleteBody: The opening goes. Applications already filed against it are kept.
Admin.jobsImageHint: Shown at the top of the job card.
Admin.jobsImageUploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.
Admin.jobsLinkFieldsUnavailable: Apply 20261115_job_application_links.sql to enable link-based jobs and images.
Admin.jobsErr_application_link_required: An application URL is required for a link-based job.
Admin.jobsErr_image_invalid: Choose an image uploaded to this site.
Admin.jobsErr_slug_required: A link needs at least one Latin word in the English title.
Admin.jobsErr_unavailable: The openings table is not in this database yet.
Admin.linkedAccountHint: Attach this technician to an account that already exists, so they can sign in to the dashboard.
Admin.linkedAccountSet: Set what they may open and change on the staff access page.
Admin.locationHint: The coordinates the directions button opens. Copy them from Google Maps.
Admin.manager_cycle: That link would make a loop in the reporting line — one of them already reports to the other.
Admin.mapSub: Every governorate is a press — revenue, orders and customers, all time. Collected orders count as Wasit.
Admin.mapUnattributed: {count} delivery orders ({amount}) carry no province and are not on the map.
Admin.measurementUnavailable: Run 20261028_visitor_measurement.sql in the Supabase SQL editor, and orders and revenue by source, ad and campaign will appear here.
Admin.measurementUnavailableTitle: Ad measurement is not switched on yet
Admin.name_required: Give the band a heading in both Arabic and English.
Admin.needsRoleBody: {count} of them take repair tickets on an account whose role is still customer, so no permission can be given to them. Open the row and choose a role.
Admin.needsRoleTitle: People who work here are still filed as customers
Admin.newCustomersExplain: People with exactly one dealing so far — an order, a repair or a buy-back. The second one is the job.
Admin.newEmployeeHint: Choose the person's account, then set their job and what they may see and do in each area. It applies to their account the moment you save.
Admin.noAdVisits: No visits from paid ads in this period.
Admin.noCampaigns: No tagged campaigns. Add ?utm_campaign= to your ad links to see them here.
Admin.noCoupons: No discount codes yet. The cart can already accept one — this is where they are created.
Admin.noCustomerNote: The customer left no note with this request.
Admin.noDiscounts: Nothing in the catalogue is discounted right now.
Admin.noFeatured: No product is on the home page yet.
Admin.noInteractions: No interactions recorded in this window.
Admin.noLinkedAccountBody: They can be assigned tickets, but cannot sign in. Ask them to register on the site, then come back and pick their account here.
Admin.noPhotos: The customer sent no photos with this request.
Admin.noPosts: No posts yet. Write the first one.
Admin.noSubcategories: No subfilters yet. Add one to narrow this category further.
Admin.not_your_team: That person is outside your team.
Admin.notePlaceholder: Something the next person at the counter should know…
Admin.notesUnavailable: Notes need a database update that has not been applied yet (20260920_customer_notes.sql).
Admin.notifyAccountsOnly: A notification is shown inside an account, so only registered accounts appear here — and most of this shop's customers buy as guests. Reach those from the WhatsApp button on their order or ticket.
Admin.notifyAudienceChosenHint: A message for one person or several, seen by nobody else.
Admin.notifyAudienceEveryoneHint: One row that reaches everybody signed in, including whoever signs up tomorrow.
Admin.notifyAutomatic: A change to an order, a repair or a buy-back notifies the customer it belongs to, in their own language, with nobody typing anything. They appear in the log below beside whatever is sent from here.
Admin.notifyAutomaticTitle: What the shop sends by itself
Admin.notifyHint: Sends a notification to every signed-in customer. Guests are reached by WhatsApp from the queues.
Admin.notifyLinkHint: A path without the language prefix, such as /store?offer=true — the prefix is added for each reader.
Admin.notifyLogHint: Both languages, side by side — a record exists to be checked, and half of what there is to check is whether the other half went out.
Admin.notifyResendHint: Sends this announcement to every customer again, with the same wording. The earlier record is kept.
Admin.notifyTokens: Type {'{'}name{'}'} for their name, {'{'}orders{'}'} for how many orders they have placed, and {'{'}spent{'}'} for what they have spent. Each is replaced per customer as the message is sent, so one composition becomes many sentences.
Admin.notifyTokensTitle: Write in the customer's own figures
Admin.notifyUnavailable: The notifications tables have not been created in the database yet, so nothing can be sent or listed. Apply 20260824_notifications.sql.
Admin.offerKindHint: Each kind is driven by its own rule, so only the fields it uses are shown. "Flash sale" is what gets pinned to the home page.
Admin.offerProductHint: This product leads the offers rail at the top of the home page, and the countdown runs to the end date below. Leave the end date empty to keep it open-ended.
Admin.offerScopeEmpty: Nothing chosen yet — an offer scoped to nothing applies to nothing.
Admin.offerScopeHint: Narrow the discount to part of the catalogue, or leave it on the whole cart.
Admin.offerScopeHint_products: One or several, picked by hand
Admin.offerScopeNotEnforced: Checkout still applies this discount to the whole cart. The scope is saved and shown here, but the pricing function has to be updated before it changes what a customer is charged — see supabase/migrations/20260819_offer_scope.sql.
Admin.offersRailDiscountHint: Applied to every product on this band — the hand-picked ones and anything the filter brings in.
Admin.offersRailDiscountWarning: This changes the price on the products themselves, so it applies everywhere they appear — not only on the home page. Removing a product from this band clears the discount again.
Admin.offersRailEndsHint: Drives the countdown beside the heading. Leave it empty for an open-ended offer and no clock is drawn.
Admin.offersRailFallback: Empty this panel and there is no offers band on the home page — there is no automatic fallback. Products below are shown in the order you set them, then topped up from the filter.
Admin.offersRailHint: The first rail a visitor sees. Choose what goes in it instead of leaving the order to whichever discount is largest.
Admin.offersRailPickedHint: Shown first, in the order you set here.
Admin.offersRailScopeHint: Fills the rest of the band from a category or brand, so it stays full as stock turns over.
Admin.offersRailVisibleHint: Turning this off keeps everything below and takes the band off the storefront. It does not undo the discount — the products keep the price the band gave them.
Admin.orderSearchPlaceholder: Order code, customer name, number, address, notes…
Admin.owner_role_forbidden: Only an owner can give someone an owner's role.
Admin.parent_required: Choose the category it belongs to.
Admin.phone_invalid: A phone number here looks like 07XXXXXXXXX.
Admin.postBodyHint: Paragraphs separated by a blank line. ## starts a heading, - starts a list item, **bold** and [links](https://…) work.
Admin.postCategoryHint: Which filter the post sits under on the news page.
Admin.postCoverHint: Shown on the card and above the article. Wide pictures work best.
Admin.postExcerptHint: One or two lines under the title on the news page. Optional.
Admin.postMediaHint: Pictures upload here; a video is a YouTube link. They appear under the article.
Admin.postSlugHint: The part after /news/. Derived from the English title when left empty.
Admin.printThanks: Thank you for choosing Al-Esnad | Phone: {phones}
Admin.psStage_starting: Preparing and connecting to the printers…
Admin.psStage_confirming: Sent — waiting for Windows to confirm…
Admin.psStage_waking: The print agent was not running — starting it on this computer…
Admin.psOutcome_all_done: Windows reports every paper was sent to its printer.
Admin.psOutcome_sent: Everything was sent; Windows has not yet confirmed {count} of them — check the printer.
Admin.psOutcome_problems: {count} of the papers did not print or need attention.
Admin.psOutcome_skipped: Everything that could print was sent. {count} were skipped because their printer isn't available ({printers}) — print them through the browser dialog, or retry once it's connected.
Admin.psOutcome_none_available: No printer is available for these papers right now — print through the browser dialog or open the printer setup.
Admin.psPhase_queued: Accepted by the Windows print queue
Admin.psPhase_done_printed: Windows reports it was sent to the printer
Admin.psPhase_done_left: Left the print queue — check it came out
Admin.psPhase_unconfirmed: Sent, with no confirmation from Windows — check the printer
Admin.psPhase_uncertain: Contact was lost while sending — it may have printed
Admin.psReason_no_printer: There is no printer for this paper on this computer.
Admin.psReason_printer_missing: “{printer}” is not installed on this computer.
Admin.psReason_not_connected: “{printer}” is not plugged in right now.
Admin.psReason_render_failed: The paper could not be prepared: {detail}
Admin.psReason_rejected: The printer or Windows refused the job: {detail}
Admin.psReason_connection_lost: Lost contact with the print agent on this computer.
Admin.psReason_skipped_after_failure: Not sent because the same printer failed just before.
Admin.psReason_cancel_failed: Could not remove it from the queue: {detail}
Admin.psProblem_not_running_title: The print agent could not be started on this computer
Admin.psProblem_not_running: We tried to start it and it did not answer. Press “Start it and try again” — and if the browser asks about opening “Al-Esnad print agent”, allow it and tick “always allow”. If it keeps happening, run install.cmd in tools/print-agent once on this computer, or print through the browser dialog.
Admin.psProblem_not_installed_title: This computer is not set up for printing
Admin.psProblem_not_installed: The print program is not installed on this computer, so the browser cannot start it. Open the print-agent folder and run install.cmd once, then allow the browser to open “Al-Esnad print agent”. This is done once per computer.
Admin.psProblem_blocked_title: The browser blocked the connection to this computer
Admin.psProblem_blocked: Click the lock icon beside the address → Site settings → “Local network access” → Allow, then try again.
Admin.psProblem_timeout_title: The print agent did not answer
Admin.psProblem_timeout: If the browser asks to allow connecting to apps on this device, choose Allow, then try again.
Admin.psProblem_unsupported_title: Direct printing works on the shop’s PC
Admin.psProblem_unsupported: This device is not the shop’s Windows PC. Print through the browser’s dialog instead.

Tour.welcomeBody: A short tour of the shop — how to find a device, what the prices mean, and where repairs, replacement and tracking live. Under a minute, and you can close it at any point.
Tour.tilesBody: Twelve ways in. Eight are the shop's departments — phones, tablets, watches, audio and the rest — and four are ready-made filters: used devices, everything on offer, what can be paid in instalments, and the top rated.
Tour.offersBody: Everything discounted right now. Where the shop has set an end date you will see a countdown; where it has not, there is no clock — the offer simply runs until it is withdrawn.
Tour.menuTitle: Everything in the shop, in one list
Tour.menuBody: Press “Store” in the bar from any page for every category, every make and the shortcuts in one panel — the quickest way back to an aisle or a type once you know what you are after.
Tour.cardBody: Tap the card to open the product with its specs and reviews, or the heart to save it to your wishlist.
Tour.filtersBody: Narrow by make, storage, memory, branch, condition or price. Pick a department first and a second row appears above the results with that department's own types.
Tour.cartBody: Everything you add shows up here. Open the basket to check your order and pick how to pay before confirming.
Tour.repairBody: Device not working? Tell us the brand and what is wrong, and you will see an approximate price before committing to anything.
Tour.tradeInBody: Sell us your old device, or put its value toward a new one. Answer four questions for an approximate price.
Tour.trackBody: Enter your order code and phone number to see where it has got to — no account needed.
Tour.replayBody: That is the tour. Press this button at the bottom of the page to watch it again whenever you like.
Tour.compareTitle: Compare two devices side by side
Tour.compareBody: Pick two devices and see the difference in one table: screen, RAM, storage, battery and camera.
Tour.accountBody: One account keeps your orders, repairs and replacements in one place — no codes to remember.
Tour.socialBody: Arrivals and offers usually go out on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok before anywhere else. Around 120,000 people follow the shop between them.
Tour.branchesBody: Three branches in Al Kut. Each card has the address, the phone number and a button that opens it on the map.
Tour.inviteTitle: A quick tour of the shop?
Tour.inviteBody: In under a minute we point out where the offers are, how to filter, how the cart, repair booking and replacement work, and how to track an order. You can stop at any step.
Tour.brandsBody: Every aisle opens on the makes we carry. Tap one and you get that brand's own offers, best sellers and new arrivals — not the whole shop with a filter on it.
Tour.needsTitle: Or tell us what it is for
Tour.needsBody: Games, photography, drawing, studying — each one ranks the devices by the figures that actually matter for it.
Tour.priceBody: Phone prices move, so we publish a range and settle the exact figure with you. Found it cheaper somewhere? The link under it tells us and we will call you.
Tour.rewardsBody: Points on every order, repair and trade-in — and one strike of the diamond a day. Spend them on discounts, or on a gift from the shop.
Tour.supportBody: The shop's number, WhatsApp and email are all in here — and an assistant who answers questions about what we actually have in stock.
Tour.newsBody: What is new in the shop — arrivals, offers, events and advice from the counter. Filter by kind or search the lot from the chips at the top.
Tour.aboutBody: Al-Esnad has been selling and repairing phones in Al Kut since 2004. The story is worth two minutes.
Tour.wantedBody: Tell us what you are after and we will look for it. The market is bigger than the shelf.
Tour.jobsBody: Openings at the counter, on the bench, on the delivery round and behind the accounts. Each one lists what the job involves, and you apply over WhatsApp — no form to fill in.
Tour.typesBody: Under the makes, an aisle breaks into its own types — here, phone types. The same row appears in the catalogue the moment you pick a category, under the category chips, so you can narrow to exactly the sort of thing you want.

Story.open: Our motto — with Al-Esnad, trust grows
Story.title: With Al-Esnad, trust grows
Story.p1: “Wiyya” is the Iraqi word for “with”, and we say it the way we say it across the counter every day. “Esnad” is what you lean on when you need it. Trust is the part we plant with our customers and work to grow with every dealing.
Story.p2: We hold the quality high through three commitments: a genuine device, checked before it reaches you; repair by technicians who know the device in front of them; and a clear price, said before any work begins.
Story.p3: What we are after is a relationship that lasts, not a sale that ends at the door: we stand behind what we sell, and we stay with you through the servicing, the replacement and every question that comes after.
Story.p4: Since 2004 we have measured ourselves by one thing: do you come back next time, and do you send us the people you trust?
